sections.title: Introducing Wuyang
sections.description: Support Hero Wuyang bends the rules of healing and now you can bend them too, before his official debut in Season 18. This prodigy from Wuxing University’s Water College is all about rhythm, disruption, and flow-based control. In this limited-time Hero trial, get hands on with Wuyang's hybrid Xuanwu staff, mobility-driven abilities, and gameplay-shifting perks to unlock the rhythm of Support done differently. Smart positioning and sharp aim pay off big here, so dive in and make an early splash with Wuyang from Aug 14–18

general: Not available in Competitive Play during the Hero Trial
Fire a damaging water orb. Hold to control its trajectory and empower its explosion.
Place a passive healing stream on an ally. Hold on the target to manually heal at an improved rate, consuming resource.
Ride water to move faster and jump higher.
Send a water wave forward that increases the amount of healing received by allies and knocks back enemies.
Protect an ally or yourself with water that detonates after a short duration. The explosion knowns down enemies and massively heals the host target.

lines_en: Gain 10 ammo and 33% healing resource when Rushing Torrent is activated.
When you deal damage with water orbs, increase Restorative Stream’s passive healing by 40% for 2 seconds.
Guardian Wave rewinds to its starting location. Deals 50% decreased damage while rewinding.
Simultaneously control 3 water orbs that deal 60% decreased damage and have 25% decreased empowered explosion radius.
